export.how: Figma export SVG with 'Include id attribute', sent by the team; then colours replaced by the nearest existing tokens (team chose option B, 2026-10-09): #003747 and #034152 -> #013746, #9BF4DE and #61E7CB -> #8CF9E5, #03637C and #036C87 -> #044F64, #DFDFDF -> #CBD2D1, shadow matrix #01212a -> #032e39. The dark table rows (#034152) merge with the card as a result (team accepted). Figma itself was not changed (library component). Embedded noise PNG re-encoded losslessly as an indexed PNG. Original: source/figma-export.raw.svg.
